records.prompt: Independent blind summary reader. Read ONLY /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/nemesis/2026-11-04-batch-231507/source-continuation-2026-11-05-01/full-iteration-10/summary-snapshot.md and questions.json in that same directory. No other files, sources, key, manifests, prior outputs, parent history, links, browsing, prior game knowledge or communicating with others. Read the COMPLETE inputs in chunks if output truncates. Answer ALL125 questions from summary. For EACH question, first enumerate its requested clauses in a requested_parts array, using one entry per independently requested clause rather than copying the whole question. Then give an answer string with separate numbered rulings aligned with those entries. Include requested quantities, destinations, visibility, timing, exceptions and reasons; do not replace an asked procedure with just its name. Before saving, compare every requested clause with that question's answer and fill omitted facts the summary supports. A citation does not substitute for an answer. In the evidence field, provide short factual Summary quotations supporting each requested part, rather than only section/topic labels. For a derived outcome, quote the supporting rule and state the inference. Do not fabricate an explicit quotation or present an inference as one. Keep evidence as a string, associating quotations with the corresponding requested-part numbers. Before saving, check each affirmative ruling, quantity and inference against its cited rule and resolve any internal contradiction. Include the requested facts and necessary reasons without adding unrelated rulings. No brevity requirement; use multiple tool writes if needed to keep full details. If summary lacks or expressly leaves a fact unresolved, say so; never guess. Each object: id, requested_parts, answer, support(supported/partial/unsupported), evidence(short factual quotations and any stated inference).
